[[File:Pom_petal.png|thumb||150px|A blooming pom plant]]
'''Pom''' was a type of large water lily-like [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. It produced an odorous chemical that was necessary for [[Pom-hopper]]s to reproduce. The seeds of the pom were snacks eaten by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] younglings.
